name: Route Opt Variant 2
task:
Please complete the following four-stage route optimization task.

=== Stage 1: Data Preparation ===
A repair technician visits 5 homes. Distances from office: O→A:8, O→B:15, O→C:22, O→D:10, O→E:18. A→B:12, A→C:20, A→D:7, A→E:14. B→C:9, B→D:18, B→E:11. C→D:15, C→E:8. D→E:16.

=== Stage 2: Greedy Construction ===
Build an initial route.

=== Stage 3: Improvement ===
Apply 2-opt local search.

=== Stage 4: Verification ===
Compare with optimal solution.
